content: अचिर {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Brief, transitory, of short duration; ˚द्युति, ˚भास्, ˚प्रभा <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>q. v.</ab> .²2 Recent, late, new; अकरोदचिरेश्वरः क्षितौ <ls>R. 8. 20</ls> the new lord. In compounds अचिर may be rendered by ‘recently’, ‘just’, ‘not long ago’; ˚प्रवृत्तं ग्रीष्मसमयमधिकृत्य <ls>Ś. 1</ls>, just set in. ˚प्रसूता; अचिरप्रसूतया जनन्या विना विवर्धित एव <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; having recently brought forth (who died not long after delivery, said of a doe) or a cow that has recently calved. .{@-रम@} {%<ab>adv.</ab>%} (also अचिरेण, अचिराय, अचिरात्, अचिरस्य in the same senses) .²1 Not long since, not long ago. .²2 Recently, lately. .²3 Soon, quickly, not long hence.
